q1_issues.issue: (Member downtown_washington district) types the place as a district, a kind no word in the sentence supplies — world knowledge added as content, which the Core-patterns "point at the words" test forbids.

q2_gaps: Coordinated NPs as the object of a locative PP ("in Downtown Washington and northern Virginia") — nothing says whether the distributive-by-default rule replicates the event per conjunct or two obliques stack on one event.

A causation-flavored verb ("triggered") whose object is an event-denoting NOUN rather than a clausal complement — the role test points at Patient (creation) while the causative bullet points at Theme (reified complement).
Distributing a group predication to its members by rule when the group fills a non-subject role (Theme of "inconvenienced") — the per-member rule is specified only for plural subjects.
notes: Naming (Downtown Washington as one capitalized run), the northern-Virginia sub-region witness, the phrasal back_up with no genus, and the vague-quantity CardinalityPhrase all follow the instruction set exactly. The As atom is anchored on the relative-clause event rather than the sentence's matrix trigger event — a defensible scope reading, but it is not the main clause.
